fast_mom.cleaned_transcript: Good morning, everyone. Welcome to our quarterly platform synchronization meeting. Today, we need to address database query latency, the customer dashboard redesign, and the new or worth-to security migration. Let's start with the database performance issues reported in production. Thanks, Elena. Over the weekend, query latency spiked to 800 ms during peak traffic. The pause is missing indexes on the audit log table and inefficient connection pooling in our microservices. That latency directly impacted the web dashboard. Use the sessions were timing out while loading recent order histories, causing multiple client complaints. From the QA perspective, we reproduced the timeout on the staging environment under a simulated load of 2,000 concurrent requests. We need both an immediate database index patch and query optimization. Kavita, what is your proposed timeline for deploying the database fix to production? I will add the composite database indexes and optimize connection pool parameters by Wednesday at 3 PM. Approved. We decide to schedule the database maintenance window for Wednesday night at 11 PM. to minimize user impact. Regarding the customer dashboard redesign, our front-end team has finished the initial mockups and responsive layout components. However, we are waiting for the updated API schemers from back end. The GraphQL schema definition is ready. I will publish the updated API schema documentation to the developer portal by Thursday at 12 PM. Perfect. Once that schema is published, I'll integrate the new dashboard widgets and finale eyes front-end responsive testing by next Monday at 5 PM. Before we push the new dashboard to production, security must review the third-party charting libraries. We detected two updated dependencies with reported vulnerabilities. Good catch. David, what is needed to clear those vulnerabilities? I will run a full security vulnerability audit on front-end dependencies and share the remediation report by Friday at 2 PM. I will upgrade the vulnerable charting dependencies to their latest patched versions as soon as David shares the audit report. Excellent. Let's address our third topic, worth two migration. David, what is our status on deprecating legacy basic authentication? Legacy authentication has already been deprecated on staging. We decide to enforce mandatory OAuth two authentication on all production endpoints starting the first of next month. Agreed. I will draft the official customer migration announcement and publish it to the product blog by Friday at 4 PM. Great progress to day team. Database maintenance is set for Wednesday, API schemers on Thursday, security audit and blog post on Friday and dashboard integration by Monday. Let's adjourn.
